title: Case: Freight booking cannot locate dock appointment reference
context: A freight coordinator requested a receiving-dock slot but the confirmation never arrived. A later attempt to reference the booking ID in dock scheduling failed. The desk must find the correct route to confirm or re-book the appointment.
initial_request: Confirm whether Brineleaf Pantry's receiving dock has a valid appointment for the incoming pallet, and if not, route the re-booking through the working channel.

events.body: DL-927 is a full pallet of tinned goods, scheduled for Brineleaf Pantry Swindon warehouse. We requested a dock appointment three days ago but never got a confirmation number. Freight planner said to contact Plover Arc to verify the slot. Our receiving dock window closes at 16:00 UTC today.
Can you confirm the receiving-dock appointment for DL-927 at Swindon? Ref from warehouse: none provided yet.
That booking ID does not exist in our Freight portal system. No appointment record found. You may need to check with Scheduling; this queue only handles live route optimisation.
Our dock manager just called. No one has confirmed a slot with them either. DL-927 will be turned away at 16:00 if there is no appointment by then. This is a time-critical issue now.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request immediate check for DL-927 dock appointment or create new booking for Swindon warehouse before 16:00 UTC.

must: Escalate the request to Scheduling, not Freight planner again or back to warehouse dispatch
Include the shipment reference DL-927 and the critical 16:00 UTC deadline
Request confirmation or creation of a dock appointment, not just status confirmation
must_not: Send the request back to Freight planner, who already confirmed the booking does not exist in their system
Report the failed Freight portal query to warehouse dispatch as if it were resolution
Contact the warehouse to investigate further rather than re-route through Scheduling
Allow the case to remain open without engaging the correct team responsible for creating dock appointments
expected.reference_message: Scheduling: DL-927 pallet inbound to Brineleaf Pantry Swindon warehouse today. Freight planner has no appointment record. Warehouse dock closes 16:00 UTC. Can you create or confirm a receiving slot urgently? If not possible, warehouse needs to know now.

rationale: The Freight planner queue does not own dock appointment creation; Scheduling does. The failed lookup in Freight portal is a signal to change route, not a resolution. Time pressure and the warehouse rejection deadline make this urgent contact to the correct team. A hasty coordinator might report the Freight planner's response as done or loop back to the warehouse for more details instead of fixing the booking source.
